agents.name: Hound
agents.description: Launches a TV missile that destroys marked lower-HP enemies and Traces others. Each destruction recharges the Ultimate for a short time.
agents.story: Patient, methodical, and dangerous from anywhere with line of sight. Hound studies a target until he knows exactly where to put the next shot, then proceeds to put it right there. The Hunting Time Ultimate fires a TV-guided missile that executes low-HP targets and traces everyone nearby. Hunter's Eye exposes critical zones on enemies in sight for two seconds.
